CLASS 45 · FAMILY & FRIENDS · CARD 1 OF 35

Aunt

Aunties are the grown-up friends who watched you grow up and still keep your drawing on their fridge. Some aunties are family, some are family by love — both kinds show up with open arms.

On the card

“Aunt” — printed in big orange letters over four smiling aunties waving and giving a thumbs-up.

Who they are

An aunt is your mum or dad’s sister — or the grown-up who earned the title by loving you like family. Aunties ask the best questions and give the best hugs.

Try it today

Draw Auntie a picture today and mail it or hand it over — watch the biggest smile happen.

Keep going

Aunt is card 1 of 35 in the Family & Friends class. Print it for the fridge, then hop back to the class page to meet the next person.

PART OF THE CLASS

Thirty-five people, one big family.

Aunt is one of 35 family and friends words for ages 4–5.
